name: hyperdrain
changelog:
• Built-in Protected Websites Browser & App Launcher: Edge-to-edge browsing with zero idle RAM/CPU overhead, real site favicons, ad/popup shield, 1-click download link handling, and instant renderer unload.
• Integrated HyperDrain Extension & Batch ZIP Capture: Native floating video downloader, golden Episode Batch/ZIP capture, and 32-stream engine handoff inside the embedded browser.
• Download-Only Eco Mode: Suppresses video frame/chunk decoding on CPU and GPU while still sniffing .m3u8/.mpd streams and Batch/ZIP links (toggleable in the browser bar).
• Smart Domain Takeover & Live Proxy/DPI Bypass Sync: Automatically tracks mirror/domain redirects and manual domain updates, supports one-click Save Domain pinning, and syncs Settings proxy changes (Direct, ByeDPI, SpoofDPI) live with automatic offline fallback.
